title: Global Outage! Microsoft Outlook and Teams Go Down for 5+ Hours
caption:
💻 Microsoft Outlook and Teams down for hours

A major Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook email, Teams and other Microsoft services for more than five hours on Thursday, Reuters reported. Problems began around 12:30 p.m. US Eastern time, and Microsoft said users in any region could be affected.

🔹 Problem reports for Outlook on Downdetector peaked at more than 138,000, according to Reuters.
🔹 Microsoft said a number of servers became unexpectedly unavailable because of elevated load, mainly hitting Exchange Online email.
🔹 Microsoft said it was returning servers to service and moving traffic, and warned that recovery would be gradual as users reconnect.

Sources: Reuters, ABC News

title: Tensions Rise! Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain
caption:
⚠️ Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain

Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said on Friday that they targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. Iran's state news agency IRNA reported the statement. AP and Al Jazeera said the claim could not be independently verified, and the US and Bahrain did not comment straight away.

🔹 The IRGC said it was a reply to an attack on a telecom tower in Sirik, a port city in southern Iran, on Thursday.
🔹 According to Reuters, it is Iran's first claimed attack on US military assets in a Gulf country since early September.
🔹 Bahrain hosts the headquarters of the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. The IRGC warned it is ready to act again.

💬 Do you think talks can stop the tension from growing? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, Reuters

title: Cuba Warning! Trump Says He Wants to Get Cuba Done Before Leaving Office
caption:
🌎 Trump Says He Wants to "Get Cuba Done" Before Leaving Office

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he wants to "get Cuba done" before he leaves office in 2029. Speaking in a radio interview with host Hugh Hewitt, he said he would consider using military force against Cuba and that his team is "watching it very closely."

🔹 Politico reported this is the first time Trump has given a timeline for possible action on Cuba.
🔹 Trump said Secretary of State Marco Rubio, whose parents are from Cuba, "would love to do it."
🔹 Since January, the US has blocked most oil shipments to Cuba, which has led to blackouts and food and fuel shortages. Cuban officials have said the island is ready for any attack.

Sources: Al Jazeera, Politico, The Hill

title: Shock Collapse! India All Out for 89 as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs
caption:
🏏 India All Out for 89 as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs

New Zealand beat India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI at Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui, on Friday. New Zealand made 333, and India were bowled out for just 89 in reply.

🔹 Fast bowler Matt Henry took 6 wickets for 27 runs. Reuters reported he took three wickets in his first over, including Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli.
🔹 Will Young scored 125 from 108 balls, his fifth ODI hundred.
🔹 India still lead the five-match series 2-1 (the third match was washed out by rain). The last match is on Sunday at the same ground.

💬 What went wrong for India today? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, Reuters, ESPNcricinfo
